carousel.short: Most judge a holiday let by the month. I judge the year.
carousel.long: Most judge a holiday let by the month. I judge the year. Some months will be negative, and that's normal.

Judge it over the year. With high financing, some months will be negative. Start with a cash cushion so they don't scare you, and look at mid-term tenants for the quiet season. Only annually can you look at it.

carousel.short: Measure against the cash you put in.
carousel.long: Measure against the cash you put in. Not against what the deal cost. Interest is a cost, but the principal the rent repays is yours, even when little reaches your account.

carousel.short: Diagram: Judge the year, and measure your own cash.
carousel.long: Diagram: Judge the year, and measure your own cash. None of this is a return promise. It's how to look at a short let bought with a mortgage.

carousel.short: Then put it next to a boring lease.
carousel.long: Then put it next to a boring lease. Compare what it leaves after management, cleaning, platforms and tax with a steady tenant: longer leases are taxed at lower rates. And if tourism stopped, would it still work? If not, we don't do it.

carousel.short: Judge the year, measure your own cash, and set the loan on purpose.
carousel.long: Judge the year, measure your own cash, and set the loan on purpose. Run the year on your own numbers, and tell me what you find.

quote.short: Quote card: "Interest is an expense, but the principal the rent repays stays with you, even when…
quote.long: Quote card: "Interest is an expense, but the principal the rent repays stays with you, even when little lands in the account." Asaf Eyzenkot, Suf Zen, founder of Realization.

cover.short: Judge the year, not the month.
cover.long: Judge the year, not the month. Asaf Eyzenkot, Suf Zen, founder of Realization.
